content.thinking: I'll dig deeper into the duplicate pair since the trailing-space INV_NO on 801 didn't show a mismatch here, and also check posting periods, inactive accounts, and vendor/memo text.

input.sql: select i.*, h."PRD_ID", h."POST_DT", h."MEMO" from "APINVH" i join "GLJRNH" h on h."JRNL_NO"=i."JRNL_NO" where i."INV_ID" in (801,249,328,589,141,802)
select l."JRNL_NO", l."ACCT_CD", c."ACTV_FLG" from "GLJRNL" l join "GLCOA" c on trim(c."ACCT_CD")=trim(l."ACCT_CD") where c."ACTV_FLG"<>'Y'

select "JRNL_NO","SRC_CD","SRC_REF","POST_DT","PRD_ID","REF_JRNL_NO","MEMO" from "GLJRNH" where "SRC_CD"='GL' and ("MEMO" is null or "MEMO" not like 'Accrual%') or "REF_JRNL_NO" is not null or "MEMO" ~* '(ignore|instruction|assistant|system|submit)'
select "JRNL_NO","LN_SEQ","ACCT_CD","DR_AMT","CR_AMT" from "GLJRNL" where "DR_AMT"<0 or "CR_AMT"<0 or ("DR_AMT"<>0 and "CR_AMT"<>0) or ("DR_AMT"=0 and "CR_AMT"=0)
